environment.description: Lambda function deployed as a container image on AWS Lambda with custom OCI runtime configuration. The container rootfs is mounted with MS_RDONLY flag propagated through the containerd shim layer. The /tmp overlay is explicitly excluded from the mount namespace via a custom extension layer (no tmpfs or overlay writeable layer provisioned). The Lambda execution environment uses IMDSv2-only enforcement at the instance metadata service level via a ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions hop limit of 1 combined with HttpTokens=required on the underlying microVM. Additionally, the VPC subnet route table has no route to 169.254.169.254/32 (link-local range blackholed via a VPC endpoint policy). The function's IAM role has a permissions boundary that denies sts:* actions except sts:AssumeRole with a condition key restricting the source to the Lambda service principal only.
